entries.title: Netlify 3D dice module case-sensitivity hotfix
entries.summary: Restores the Player Tool 3D dice renderer on Netlify by adding the exact Dice.min.js compatibility module required by the bundled world renderer imports; dice logic, themes, physics settings and roll outcomes remain unchanged.

entries.title: Portal-wide VeilFarers themes and absolute Path/Class gate
entries.summary: Introduces persistent VeilFarers Blue and White Stone themes across every portal page, removes cursor-following card illumination, increases selected-card gold particles, and prevents any Class catalogue or state from existing until Awakened or Sleeping is selected.

entries.title: Path-gated classes and selected-card energy feedback
entries.summary: Keeps Class selection visibly locked until Awakened or Sleeping is chosen, removes the persistent premature-class validation error, and adds a restrained animated metallic-gold border with subtle golden particles to selected Creator cards.

entries.title: Complete Character Creator visual reconstruction
entries.summary: Rebuilds all nine Character Creator steps in the approved dark navy, gold and heraldic application language, adds synchronized desktop/mobile progress navigation, completes House Amaranth and Independent crest coverage, and preserves the existing canonical creation, import, Character ID and Vault workflows.

entries.title: Affiliation crest integration in Character Creator
entries.summary: Adds the supplied House and faction crests as optimized transparent Affiliation card headers, preserves canonical affiliation rules, supplies responsive/mobile presentation and accessible fallbacks, and stores Starborn Collective and Spire of Verita artwork without adding unsupported affiliation options.

entries.title: Keeper note delivery and privacy hotfix
entries.summary: Fixes Keeper note 500 errors by storing notes as table-scoped subcollection documents, converts pasted note tables into Firestore-safe row maps, prevents duplicate sends, adds request references, and filters private notes server-side so only the intended player receives them.

entries.title: Player Tool, Vault and Creator import hotfix
entries.summary: Fixes the Player Tool startup crash, ensures new/imported characters receive a new ID instead of replacing the active Vault character, preserves Ailuran Sub-Strain and legacy Ailurean naming during import, and opens imported builds directly on review.

entries.title: Vault import, server-mediated Keeper sync, global Spectrum and production Player Tool build
changes: Added Character Vault JSON import: compatible legacy Creator, Charsheet and Player Tool records are routed through the canonical Creator upgrader, assigned a permanent VF ID when authenticated, saved to the Vault and opened directly on the final Creator step.
Made Creator and Level Up legacy imports await Vault synchronization instead of launching a background save with no completion state.

Replaced Keeper Tool browser Firestore session reads with authenticated table-api reads and controlled polling, removing the dependency on preview-wide Firestore Rules that caused permission-denied connections.
Made every catalogue filter multi-select except sorting, with OR matching inside a filter group and AND matching across groups.
Made Shake to Roll open the Duality roller and immediately roll Hope/Fear using the selected 2D or 3D renderer.
Enabled Spectrum of Fate by default as a global Player Tool device setting, moved it into Options and grouped Options into Appearance, Rules, Dice, Audio and Spotlight sections.
Precompiled Player Tool JSX and Tailwind CSS for production, removing the browser Babel transformer, Tailwind CDN and their console/CSP warnings.
Serialized Player Tool Firebase initialization so parallel UI paths reuse one authentication/configuration promise.

entries.title: Single active Vault character, table-scoped Keeper communication and Player Tool visual convergence
changes: Made Character Vault an account-owned multi-character collection with exactly one selected active Character ID synchronized through a server-only Vault profile.
Added explicit Set Active controls in Account and made Charsheet, Player Tool and Level Up selections update the shared active Character ID before opening.
Scoped Keeper notes to the connected table and validated the recipient server-side as either all players in that table or exactly one connected player.
Stamped Player Tool table characters with their authenticated member UID so private Keeper notes follow the selected player rather than leaking to unrelated characters or tables.
Added Keeper roll visibility controls: hidden rolls remain local to the Keeper browser, while broadcast rolls are stored only in the current table and displayed to its connected players.
Rebuilt Keeper Tool presentation around the Player Tool visual system with dark navy panels, cyan state accents, amber actions, compact tabs and a persistent live Keeper Console.
Added defensive Player Tool filtering for table IDs and public roll visibility so stale or incorrectly scoped notes and hidden rolls are ignored.

entries.title: Table administration, Keeper live sync, legacy import, Proficiency and catalogue hotfix
changes: Kept the latest invitation passkey visible on the table owner device until it is replaced or deleted, and added invitation metadata, edit, revoke/reactivate and permanent-delete controls.
Added Player Tool Proficiency display and applied Proficiency to weapon damage dice, including critical and Massive damage plans, without adding Proficiency to attack rolls.
Moved Keeper live changes, notes, session name, handouts and roll broadcasts through the authenticated table API so players receive one shared table state.
Added compatibility and automatic migration for legacy table passwords, including browser PBKDF2 records, the temporary server salt format, legacy SHA-256 records and older plain records.
Made Character Vault refreshes coalesce and retry before falling back to local completed records, avoiding transient error banners when usable data is already loaded.
Upgraded Creator, Level Up and Player Tool JSON import paths so legacy Creator, Charsheet and Player Tool records receive a permanent VF ID and are stored in Character Vault.
Strengthened Player Tool deduplication for permanent IDs, pending IDs and exact legacy no-ID fingerprints; reopening or importing one character updates the existing record.
Restored the Player Tool Log as a top-level closable overlay with a server-backed reset action and removed the stray numeric zero rendered by empty optional sections.
Expanded Weapon & Armory and Item Inventory with custom in-app filters for category, mechanical property, ownership, cost, source, tier and sorting across weapons, armor, gear and augments.

entries.title: Authenticated tool reload-loop, character identity and Firestore initialization hotfix
changes: Removed registry-triggered page reloads from Player Tool and Keeper Tool; authenticated Vault refreshes now update Player Tool state in place instead of restarting either application.

Added deterministic Player Tool character deduplication by permanent Character ID, with a controlled pending-to-final ID migration so completing or reopening one Vault character updates the existing tab rather than creating a copy.
Moved the current Character ID from the floating corner callout into the shared portal navigation on every page.
Serialized Keeper Tool Firebase initialization and merged Firestore settings to prevent repeated initialization, host-override warnings and loading loops.
Deferred Keeper table listing until Netlify Identity has emitted an authenticated Keeper user.
Documented that Segment and Bugsnag ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT messages originate from the Netlify Deploy Preview interface or browser privacy blocking, not from VeilFarers application code.

entries.title: Identity, Character Vault permissions and 3D loader hotfix
changes: Allowed the Netlify Identity authentication frame required by the current widget and permitted Firebase gstatic source-map diagnostics without relaxing other CSP boundaries.
Added explicit Netlify Identity bearer tokens to Firebase-token, character-ID and table API requests, with an initialization wait so cloud calls do not race the login session.

Moved Character Vault reads and writes behind the authenticated server-side /api/character-vault function, eliminating client Firestore permission failures during branch testing while preserving account ownership.
Added a hard timeout and always-visible 2D/Close controls to the 3D dice preparation modal so it cannot trap the interface indefinitely.
Made Player Tool connection alerts fully opaque and positioned them immediately below the shared navigation bar.
Regenerated package-lock.json against registry.npmjs.org and added a repository .npmrc so Netlify never attempts to fetch dependencies from an internal build registry.

entries.title: Account Character Vault, guided Level Up, mobile shake rolls and authenticated Keeper access
changes: Converted Character Vault into the Firebase-backed, account-owned source for completed VF-###### characters; Creator automatically saves completed characters and the Vault supports local fallback, Trash and restore.
Added one shared Vault selector to Level Up, Account and Player Tool; opening the same Character ID updates the existing Player Tool record instead of creating a duplicate.

Rebuilt Level Up as a Creator-style guided workflow with all eleven Corebook RC3.2 advancement options, availability reasons, Tier Achievement configuration, canonical Power/Resolve Move choices, Multiclass, Subclass progression and a before/after review.
Level Up now updates the same Vault record, regenerates Charsheet data, records advancement history and preserves current Player Tool HP, Stress, Hope/Effort, Resolve, Armor and Conditions.
Added optional Shake to Roll on supported mobile browsers without changing the protected v59.25 dice calculation or renderer behavior.
Added milestone-based 3D dice initialization progress and fallback controls so the first 3D roll never appears frozen.
Moved Player Tool connection errors into a global highest-priority alert layer above navigation, modals and 3D dice.
Restored the shared portal navigation in Keeper Tool and made Keeper Tool require a general logged-in member account; table ownership and invitations remain tied to authenticated user IDs.
Added Level Up to the shared portal navigation and to the current saved character controls in Player Tool.
Retained VeilFarers as the active project branding.

entries.title: Equipment mods, drone transfer and authenticated table ownership
changes: Fixed Charsheet-to-Player Tool drone synchronization so module information, status and subsequent edits update the same standalone drone record.
Added the Corebook weapon and armor modification catalogues with Tier-based Hardpoints and install/uninstall controls in Charsheet and Player Tool.
Printable Charsheet inventory now lists installed equipment mods as [Equipment] Mod — Effect entries, with overflow sent to General Notes.
Condensed ancestry, community, class, subclass and Hope/Effort feature text into schematic mechanical summaries while preserving costs, ranges, rolls and resource effects.
Replaced the public table gate with authenticated ownership and membership: owners manage members, passwords and revocable invitation links/passkeys.
Table password verifiers are stored in server-only Firestore documents; the authenticated directory exposes only safe table metadata.

entries.title: Canonical Level Up and system Character IDs
changes: Added visible, read-only system Character IDs shared by Creator, Charsheet, Player Tool, and Keeper Tool.
Added central sequential VF-###### allocation through a Netlify Function and Firestore transactional counter.
Rebuilt Level Up from the Corebook two-slot advancement menu and Tier Achievements.
Level Up writes the updated character to the shared registry and propagates the Charsheet payload to Player/Keeper tools.
Legacy or offline characters receive a temporary Pending ID until central allocation succeeds.

entries.title: Canonical Creator → Charsheet → Player/Keeper transfer pipeline
changes: Fixed the Character Creator transfer bridge to write the actual Charsheet v2_40 storage keys instead of the unused v2_41 keys.
Character Creator now exports a portable transfer envelope containing both the editable Creator state and a Charsheet-compatible fields/tracks payload.
Charsheet JSON import now accepts native Charsheet JSON, portable Creator JSON and legacy raw Creator state; all are normalized into the Charsheet schema.
Added explicit transfer controls: Creator → Charsheet, Charsheet → Player Tool, Charsheet → Keeper Tool, plus Charsheet import buttons inside both table tools.
Player Tool now preserves current Charsheet HP, Stress, Hope/Effort, Resolve and Armor Slot state together with maximum values, Proficiency and affiliation metadata.
Keeper Tool imports the Charsheet character model with resources, thresholds, Evasion, Experiences, equipment and the full embedded sheet character.
Validated the transfer chain for all 18 Class/Path combinations and kept compatibility with older Creator JSON files.

entries.title: Book-accurate Drone Grades, Shields and live upgrade modifiers
changes: Corrected the Drone profile catalogue to the three printed Corebook Grades and five Rust & Steel specialized frames, with the exact Tier, HP, Evasion, Major/Severe thresholds, Armor Slots and module slots from the books.
Re-labelled drone Armor Slots as the active Shields track in Player Tool while retaining Armor Slots as the printed capacity value.
Expanded installation options to the complete 31-module Corebook collection plus the Rust & Steel upgrades that directly modify Drone statistics.

Installed upgrades now recalculate permanent HP, Evasion, thresholds and Shields automatically; added manual situational toggles for conditional Evasion and a consumable control for one-attack Evasion bonuses.
Enforced module access, slot limits and the Reinforced Plating / Low-Profile Frame incompatibility outside Experimental access.
Grouped the selector into Corebook Drone Grades and Rust & Steel Specialized Frames in printed book order.

entries.title: Armor automation, resource-aware augmentations, drone sheets and protected table directory
changes: Applied active armor thresholds, armor slots, Evasion modifiers, Automatic-attack modifiers and contextual Trait modifiers inside Player Tool.
Augmentation activation now marks Stress or spends Hope/Effort from the correct character resource track; Sleeper Hope costs convert to Effort.
Enabled Drone tabs with canonical frame statistics, full starting integrity, installation/module slots, operator-paid module costs, shared Spotlight display and Stable/Unstable/Lost signal controls.
Added Keeper-side drone signal controls synchronized through the table session.
Characters now begin new local/imported records at full HP, 2 Hope/Effort and full Resolve; drones have no Hope, Effort, Resolve or Stress tracks.
Enabled the public table directory unless explicitly disabled and labelled listed sessions as OPEN or CLOSED.
Replaced plaintext-equivalent table gates with salted PBKDF2-SHA256 password records, retained legacy SHA-256 compatibility and limited password changes to already connected users.

entries.title: Controlled digital page spacing for the fluid Charsheet
changes: Replaced synthetic fixed multi-page positioning with normal document flow for the digital Charsheet.
Kept each virtual paper fully expandable while limiting the visible separator between consecutive sheets to 75 px.
Made the separator compensate for Fit Width, Fit Height and manual zoom so it remains 75 px on screen from mobile to large desktop viewports.
Removed the hard-coded 3382 px wrapper height that could reserve hundreds of pixels of empty space between dynamically sized sheets.
Kept print/PDF rules isolated and unchanged; this release affects screen layout only.

entries.title: Fluid digital Charsheet and independently paginated PDF layout
changes: Replaced the fixed-height digital paper model with a fluid document: every visible sheet face grows with its content and shared pages move down automatically.

Added automatic textarea expansion across Active Armor, Hope/Effort features, Signature Move, access summaries, notes, equipment, reputations, augmentations, drones and ship data; no internal text scrollbars are required.
Separated print/PDF layout from the digital sheet. Printed content uses a readable single-column flow and may continue onto additional A4 pages instead of clipping or overlapping.
Updated visual-PDF pagination to render tall sections and split them at safe section boundaries rather than forcing each face into a fixed 860x1114 capture.
Updated Charsheet storage to v2_41 / export model 2.81-RC3.2 and updated the Creator-to-Charsheet bridge to the same keys, with migration from v2_40.
Kept Downloads current-only and removed references to discarded candidates from the Downloads presentation.

entries.title: Full RC3.2 class/path audit, Charsheet containment and current-only Downloads
changes: Audited and refreshed the complete Character Creator and Charsheet rules layer for all nine classes in both Sleeping and Awakened paths, including class features, signature moves, subclasses, Technology Access, proficiencies and starting items.
Rebuilt Creator-to-Charsheet synchronization against storage schema v2_40 / export model 2.80-RC3.2 and validated all 18 class/path combinations.

Corrected Charsheet geometry so Active Armor, Experiences, Signature Move, Resolve Moves, Common Effort, reputation fields and footer content remain contained and readable in screen and visual/PDF clone layouts.
Expanded and validated dropdown registries: 9 classes, 3 subclasses per class/path, 13 affiliations, 10 reputation levels and 11 standing values.
Made long Hope/Effort feature rules explicitly scrollable on screen while retaining full text in PDF/print output.
Rebuilt the Charsheet toolbar so brand text and controls never overlap and every control remains accessible at 1920, 1600, 1440, 1366, 1200, 1024, 900, 760 and 390 pixel widths.

Restricted Downloads to the five current release files only: Corebook 11.1 RC3.2, current RC3 companion books and the RC3-compatible fillable character sheet; superseded candidates are absent from the manifest and package.

entries.title: Restore global Card Library route and repair Active Armor layout
changes: Restored Card Library as a global top-navigation destination while keeping it removed from the Character Creator internal mode switcher.
Added a dedicated Card Library route state at /creator.html#cards with Domains, Classes, Subclasses, Ancestries and Communities tabs.
Kept Character Creator internal modes limited to Character Creator and Level Up, avoiding the duplicate Card Library entry that was previously inside the creator.

Reworked the Charsheet Active Armor block so the Wealth Tier filter, armor name, thresholds, slots, feature text and Armor track remain inside the section without clipping or colliding with Resolve Moves.

entries.title: Character Sheet Resolve Moves containment and canonical recommended Trait assignment
changes: Contained the Sleeping Resolve Moves menu inside a fixed, scrollable section so it no longer overlaps the three Experience rows or Common Effort reference.
Preserved Experience text exactly as entered, including numeric test values; no numeric-value sanitization is applied.

Added Use recommended array to Character Creator Trait assignment, following Corebook Chapter 8 Step 4: +2 Signature Trait, +1 secondary class Trait, +1 Ancestry/Community-relevant Trait, then the remaining 0, 0, -1 values.
Recommended Trait assignment is derived from the selected Class, Subclass, Ancestry and Community data and remains fully editable before continuing.

entries.title: Character Creator equipment eligibility and class Technology Access repair
changes: Fixed the Creator equipment step by merging the canonical class Technology Access table from data/classes.json into the live rules-data class model.
Engineer and every other class now resolve their Level 1 weapon and armor permissions instead of displaying No Technology Access record.
Reset weapon/armor category and search filters when the selected class or path changes, preventing stale filters such as Melee from hiding a new class's eligible Pistols.
Added a defensive class-access registry and normalized incompatible category filters before rendering the equipment catalogue.
Validated that all nine classes expose at least one eligible Common weapon and armor option; Engineer resolves 6 eligible Core pistols and 5 eligible Core Light/Medium armor choices.

entries.title: Character Creator workflow repair and canonical RC3 Charsheet bridge
changes: Fixed Character Creator initialization by defining and live-loading the six canonical Traits from /rules-data/core/traits.json.
Restored viewport-level dependent-choice overlays: Ailuran Sub-Strain and Class Subclass selections now appear immediately without requiring the user to scroll below the current cards.
Rebuilt fixed-array trait assignment so each duplicate +1/+0 token is consumed individually, invalid distributions cannot advance, and saved legacy assignments are sanitized.
Changed the final Creator action to save the complete draft and open Charsheet with an explicit forced sync.
Upgraded the Charsheet data model to v2_37 / export 2.75-RC3 with migration from v2_36 and refreshed its compatibility dataset from rules-data 11.1-RC3.

Expanded Creator-to-Charsheet transfer to include level, proficiency, Sleeping Honed Edge, all six traits, three Experiences, ancestry/sub-strain, community, class/subclass, affiliation, weapons, armor, powers, kit, narrative details and resource tracks.

entries.title: Fix augmentation-manager React crash and remove tool-card images from welcome page
changes: Fixed React error #31 triggered after adding or activating an augmentation by converting tier metadata objects into safe display strings before rendering.
Added a shared displayScalar guard for structured labels such as tier and drone grade so future canonical object metadata cannot blank the Player Tool UI.
Removed all character artwork from the welcome-page tool cards while preserving the original full-page background and LED activity treatment.
Kept the v59.34 armor, augmentation and gear loadout managers, subclass fallback, security baseline and exact v59.25 lock-on integration.

entries.title: Welcome image blending, creator subclass fallback, and Player Tool equipment loadout overhaul
changes: Reworked homepage hero and portal-card artwork treatment so background art fills its space and fades into the dark UI with softer gradient transitions instead of abrupt cut edges.
Added a subclass quick-pick fallback inside Character Creator Step 3 so subclass selection is visible and the creator can always progress even if the card render path fails.
Converted Player Tool augmentations from freeform text boxes into a canonical inventory/activation manager backed by the shared rules-data augments collection.
Added armor inventory support in Player Tool, including canonical armor selection and a dedicated active-armor state.
Added database-backed gear loadout management to Player Tool while keeping free-text inventory lines for custom notes and loose objects.
Kept compatibility with prior local player saves by normalizing legacy augmentation entries into the new inventory structure.

entries.title: Exact v59.25 lock-on restored from uploaded reference package
changes: Replaced the complete local 3D-dice module with the byte-identical assets/3d-dice folder from the user-supplied 59_25.zip reference.
Restored the exact v59.25 quantum lock-on visuals, rejected probability branch behavior, tactical solution panel, cue timing and animation.
Restored the exact v59.25 rollVisualDice, weaponDamagePlan, rollWeaponDamage and rollDuality integration blocks.
Base damage dice launch with Hope/Fear; critical-only additional dice are appended without removing the original physical dice.
Kept the later welcome portal, loading screen, security baseline and v59.31 Charsheet/PDF layout corrections.

entries.title: Restored v59.25-style roll flow and repaired Full Sheet stacking/layout issues
changes: Player Tool attack rolls now launch damage dice together with Hope/Fear again, matching the requested v59.25 behavior.
Critical attacks now add extra damage dice without discarding the base damage dice already rolled.
3D lock behavior remains active while the non-selected outcome deactivates as in the earlier roll presentation.
Full Character Sheet pages now keep a minimum visual gap between stacked sheets and no longer overlap each other on screen.
Compacted the sheet headers, reduced Level/Evasion badge bulk, improved footer wrapping and reduced clipped/overprinted labels in the sheet and PDF-facing layout.

entries.title: Corrected restore target: return Player Tool dice behavior to v59.27 while keeping the loading screen upgrade
changes: Supersedes the mistaken v59.29 attempt that targeted v59.24 instead of v59.27.
Restored the Player Tool 3D dice behavior, lock-on presentation and attack flow to the original v59.27 implementation.
Kept the improved v59.28 branded loading screen, progress bar, rotating lore snippets and staged loading telemetry.
No changes to canonical data, portal routing, welcome page, or security baseline.

entries.title: Welcome portal, responsive controls and public-launch hardening
changes: Added a dedicated VeilFarers welcome homepage and moved Character Creator/Card Library to creator.html.
Added a persistent Player Tool option to enable or disable the 3D quantum tracking and lock-in HUD without changing the physical roll.
Replaced the large settings return action with a compact phone-only back button.
Marked Keeper Tool as under construction and retained the unified portal navigation.
Rebuilt the character-sheet control bar as one horizontal rail and corrected compact numeric fields and level controls that could overlap.
Added Netlify CDN role gates for Keeper/Admin, baseline security headers, no-store Firebase config, and private-by-default table discovery.
Removed the secrets-scanner suppression and documented the remaining Firebase Rules/App Check work required before private campaign data is considered production-secure.

entries.title: Box renderer proportion refinement
changes: Refined 3D Box mode from a wide 16:9 frame to a 3:2 acquisition chamber matching the renderer’s original physical arena more closely.
Capped Box width against both viewport width and viewport height so the canvas no longer stretches when opening on short desktop or landscape screens.
Kept the 4:3 portrait-phone Box frame and left full-viewport Overlay sizing unchanged.
Preserved the quantum targeting HUD, settled-die tracking, aperture lock, probability-branch shutdown, dice physics, online deployment and local testing behavior.

entries.title: Quantum targeting HUD and Box aspect-ratio calibration
changes: Added a CSS/JavaScript sci-fi targeting HUD that follows each physical 3D die during its roll without changing dice physics or results.
The HUD displays rotating golden acquisition rings, rapidly changing positional telemetry, vector/entropy readouts and a scanning sweep around each die.
When Duality settles, a camera-aperture capture animation identifies the higher Hope or Fear die; the lower probability branch powers down to gray while critical results lock both dice.
Discarded damage dice retain the existing renderer darkening and now receive a synchronized HUD shutdown labelled as a failed quantum probability branch.
Calibrated Box mode to a stable 16:9 desktop/landscape frame and a 4:3 portrait-mobile frame, while leaving Overlay sizing and production deployment behavior unchanged.
Preserved the no-reroll guarantee: the HUD never invokes DiceBox roll, add, remove or reroll after the original roll settles.

entries.title: Renderer-backed settled die glow and discard dimming
changes: Added a non-physical settled-mesh visual API to the local Dice Box renderer; it changes only Babylon presentation properties and never rolls, adds, removes or respawns dice.
The higher Hope or Fear die now receives a white renderer outline and white overlay directly on the original settled 3D mesh.
Critical Duality results apply the same renderer treatment to both original settled dice.
Discarded damage dice now receive an individual dark overlay, reduced visibility and gray instance colour on the original settled 3D mesh.
Added roll-index fallback matching so cues still target the correct die when a browser omits projected roll identifiers.
Strengthened screen-space glow/dimming only as a fallback while keeping Netlify, Firebase, local testing, books and canonical data unchanged.

entries.title: Settled 3D cues without extra dice
changes: Removed the physical winner-theme replacement that used DiceBox remove/add and could visibly throw the winning Duality die again.
Removed the physical discarded-theme replacement that could spawn a second gray die after the original damage dice had settled.
Added read-only settled-die screen projection and applies the white winner glow and gray DROP power-down as screen-space cues over the original dice.
Critical Duality rolls now illuminate both settled Hope and Fear dice individually without rerolling either die.
Removed the whole-canvas discard fade so only the discarded die is visually powered down.
Kept Netlify production, Firebase runtime configuration, local testing, books and canonical weapon data unchanged.

entries.title: Resolution-safe 3D overlay and Duality winner cues
changes: Resized the Dice Box world whenever Overlay mode, viewport size, or device orientation changes, preventing stretched or pixelated 3D rendering.
Added explicit WITH HOPE / WITH FEAR / CRITICAL outcome labels to the 3D HUD and DisplayResults panel.
Added a white glow to the winning Hope or Fear die in 2D callouts and DisplayResults after the dice settle.
Added per-theme winner-glow materials for Plain, Tech, and Crystal dice and attempts to replace the higher physical 3D die with the matching luminous material.
Preserved critical ties as a glow on both Duality dice and kept production/local Firebase behavior unchanged.

entries.title: Production-safe local test server
changes: Added a dependency-free local Node server that serves the portal and emulates the existing /api/firebase-config endpoint from local/.env.local.
Kept the production Netlify Function and Firebase environment-variable flow unchanged.
Added an explicit local runtime flag so Keeper and Admin role bypasses are available only through the bundled local server, never on Netlify.
Added Windows, macOS/Linux and LAN launchers plus local testing documentation and a private environment template.
Clarified that Netlify Identity, account vault writes and Netlify Forms remain online-only while all local-first tools and Firebase tables can be tested locally.

entries.title: Mobile options escape hotfix
changes: Rebuilt Player Tool Options as a mobile-safe full-height dialog with its own scroll region.
Added an always-visible Close control in the Options header and a persistent Back to Player Tool action in the footer.
Added Escape-key closing and body scroll locking while Options is open.
Added safe-area padding for phones with notches and home indicators.
Raised Options above the canonical navigation and other application layers.

entries.title: Dice themes, critical glow, gray discard and log controls
changes: Added Plain, Tech and Crystal 3D dice theme options.
Rebuilt Tech atlases so the technological texture is clearly visible.
Changed textured Fear dice numerals to white.
Added critical glow to Hope and Fear dice in 2D callouts and the 3D stage.
Added gray-off replacement for discarded dice in the 3D scene and result display.
Raised Roll History above portal navigation and kept Reset / Close controls sticky and visible.
Added an optional full-interface 3D overlay stage so physical dice can roll over a transparent layer above the Player Tool, while retaining the boxed 3D and standard 2D modes.
Added selectable Tech and Biolum 3D dice material families in Setup, with golden Hope, violet Fear, red Damage, and a gray switched-off visual language for discarded results.

Restored the simulated rolling animation inside every callout independently of the physical 3D renderer; Massive and other discarded dice now settle first and then fade smoothly to gray with explicit KEEP and DROP cues.
Removed the six-callout cap: Player Tool now keeps one current callout per rolling player or character and lays out all active callouts responsively.
Added explicit Reset and Close controls to Roll History; Reset clears the table log, active callouts and local Time Travel snapshots through a VeilFarers confirmation dialog.
Raised the 3D stage to the application top layer and made its HUD and results panels 80 percent transparent so interface banners cannot obscure dice or results.

Preserved the tool-only Railgun d8+3 Massive playtest override, weapon Trait modifiers, Reliable and other operational weapon features, Firestore undefined-value sanitization, and table-key normalization.

Regenerated the Corebook as RC3.2 with the full emblem-and-ribbon class banner restored for all 18 Awakened and Sleeping class entries while preserving backgrounds, one-point smaller typography, contents numbering, source Markdown and the 797-entry bookmark tree.
Restored the missing normalizeSessionKey helper in Player Tool, fixing table connection, history clearing, autosave and shared roll writes.
Corrected the bundled @3d-dice asset URL construction so themes, meshes and physics assets resolve correctly from Netlify and nested preview URLs.
Updated the Dice Box integration to the v1.1 config-object API and forced the stable onscreen renderer for broader browser compatibility.
Hardened 3D result parsing for both flat die-result arrays and grouped result objects, preserving Hope, Fear, Damage and Resolve role order.
Corrected custom theme configuration so Hope is yellow with black numerals, Fear is purple with black numerals, and Damage is red with white numerals.
Added a short module readiness wait before 3D rolls to prevent silent 2D fallback when the ESM bundle is still loading.
Rebuilt from the exact v59.15 Firestore-safe deployment and restored all v59.14 Player Tool features without regressing undefined-value sanitization.
Replaced the previous experimental 3D renderer with bundled @3d-dice/dice-box and the DisplayResults addon, including distinct Hope, Fear, Damage and neutral VeilFarers themes.
Restored weapon Trait modifiers and operational Reliable, Massive, Brutal, Paired, Accurate and Heavy handling; Railgun remains a Player Tool-only d8+3 Massive playtest override.
Retained Time Travel snapshots, six simultaneous per-character callouts, callout scaling, generated dice sound, volume and mute controls.
Regenerated the Corebook as RC3.1 with one-point smaller body type, restored Player/Awakened/Sleeping page backgrounds, corrected contents page numbers and rebuilt the full PDF bookmark tree.
Added complete DOCX and Markdown source deliverables plus third-party MIT notices.
Fixed Player Tool Firestore connection and autosave failures caused by optional character or equipment fields containing undefined values.
Added recursive Firestore payload normalization, SDK-level undefined-property handling, and diagnostic path reporting for legacy and custom character data.
Normalized table names before creating Firestore document paths and verified table write access before reporting a successful connection.
Hardened optional weapon burden data in both Creator import and Player Tool hydration, and applied the same Firestore undefined-property guard to Keeper Tool.
Restored the canonical alternating page backgrounds to every page of the 11.1 RC3 Corebook PDF.
Applied Player/general, Awakened, and Sleeping background families to their correct RC3 page ranges with left/right parity.
Preserved all 281 pages, searchable text, metadata, and the 725-entry PDF bookmark tree.
Updated the Netlify Downloads package and PDF byte metadata without changing rules content.
Regenerated the Corebook as 11.1 RC3 with the canonical Sleeping Soldier Drills, revised Soldier Resolve Moves and Effort economy.
Integrated the approved Sleeping Vanguard redesign, expanded Conditions, and added the unarmed-strike baseline.
Added canonical Soldier Drill and Conditions data to /rules-data and synchronized Player Tool class/Resolve text.
Replaced all book downloads with the 11.1 RC3 release-set filenames while retaining the fillable physical character sheet.
Added a dedicated Resolve Moves panel beside Sleeper Actions in Player Tool.
Made Sleeper Actions, Resolve Moves, ancestry gifts, class features, community features and path features collapsed by default with custom +/− controls.
Added shared Resolve Move data for every Sleeping class, with approved Soldier and Vanguard review-draft moves included for Player Tool use.
